title: Range pins and semantic-hash fallback for stable model deployments
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem statement: Customers need a concise yet expressive way to declare deployment stability requirements without pinning to a single commit hash. Current pinning options (exact tag, semver, commit ref) force either too much rigidity (hash) or ambiguity (loose tag). This ticket proposes two related features: (1) 'range pins' for semver-like constraints that express acceptable upgrade ranges (e.g., >=1.4.0 <2.0.0) and (2) a deterministic semantic-hash fallback rule so the runtime can safely pick the latest matching artifact while preserving reproducibility when a specific hash is provided. Goals: - Define API/SDK surface for range pins and combined selectors (tag OR range OR hash). - Specify deterministic resolution precedence: exact hash -> semver range -> exact tag -> channel alias -> latest compatible. - Design a graceful runtime fallback path that logs and returns chosen ref when range matches multiple artifacts. - Ensure SDK validation surfaces clear warnings/errors for ambiguous pins. - Add telemetry fields to capture resolution decisions for audit and debugging. Non-goals: automatic migration of existing pins or changing default pin resolution behavior without explicit customer opt-in. Requirements: - API: accept pin selectors as strings with clear grammar; return resolved ref in response metadata. - SDKs: add client-side validation, a resolver preview API (dry-run), and helper utilities to render human-friendly resolution explanations. - Runtime: support atomic resolution decision and emit events that include resolved_ref, candidate_list, and resolution_reason. - Console: show pin breadcrumbs on the model detail page and callouts when range pins could match newer major versions. Compatibility constraints: - Preserve existing behavior when a single hash or tag is used. - Range pins must be opt-in per model or via account policy. - Security review required since mismatches could affect regulatory guarantees.
